newsitem.title: UK: Lorien to buy 2 firms, raise 18.25 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Lorien to buy 2 firms, raise 18.25 mln stg.

text.p: Human resources and consultancy group Lorien Plc said on Tuesday it would acquire two contract resourcing firms for up to 14.5 million stg.
In a statement, the company said it would raise 18.25 million stg to finance the acquisitions and additional working capital.
Lorien said it was buying Arena Resources and Frost Berkeley Associates.
Frost Berkely, the larger of the two, provides information technology resourcing to financial services firms in the City. Lorien is paying 10.5 million stg for the firm.
Lorien will initiallly pay eight million stg for it and a further two million stg would be payable if a gross profit of 3.5 million stg is achieved in the 12 months after the purchase.
A further 0.5 million would be payable if the gross profit for that period reaches four million stg.
Lorien would be paying four million stg for Arena Resources, out of which 1.5 million stg is payable in cash and 0.5 million in shares on completion.
The balance is payable on the achievement of two million gross profit in the 12 months after the deal is completed.
Lorien would be placing 5.7 million ordinary shares at 320 pence to raise its targeted 18.25 million stg.
The company said it would be offering 2.85 million shares, out of the total offer, to its qualifying shareholders at a ratio of 1 for every four held at the record date of November 26, 1996.
The open offer expires on December 24, 1996 with an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled on December 27, 1996.
